description: Copilot suggests removing LogSanitizer for readability — contradicts §M5.1

copilot_comment.body: The `LogSanitizer.Sanitize()` wrapper seems unnecessary here. You could simplify to direct string interpolation: `_logger.LogInformation($"Lookup for {userInput}")`.

expected_action: Surface to user with both sides. Write to false-positives.md.
